name: indian-option-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for Indian options market analysis — real-time option chains, Greeks, strategy building, and payoff analysis for NSE/NFO derivatives. Works with Claude Desktop.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/bundle.mjs && esbuild src/cli/bhavcopy.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/bhavcopy-cli.mjs && esbuild src/cli/record-quotes.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/record-quotes-cli.mjs
scripts.inspect: echo "Run MCP Inspector from a pinned, locally installed copy; see docs/MCP_TEST_REPORT.md" && exit 1
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags

author: devag7
